dedupe_keys.name: cd34 stations d epuration et points de rejet des effluents traites de l herault

description: [CD34] Stations d'épuration et points de rejet des effluents traités de l'Hérault is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservice.siglr.org. Installation of treatment plants and installation of treated effluent discharge points in the Hérault department with their characteristics. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "[CD34] Treatment plants and discharge points for treated effluent from the Hérault" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2015-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
